name: protected_distance_direction_v13
method: Algebraic weight-space programming without training or gradients
hypothesis: The denoiser adds projected trunk-pair features and reference-distance features before normalizing attention biases. The trunk projection has 6.18 percent of its squared weight norm along the reference-distance direction. Remove that rank-one component so the trunk cannot directly overwrite the distance channel before the pair MLP. This does not prove that the overlap is harmful; the intervention tests that causal hypothesis while retaining all other trunk directions and reference weights.
